value.rationale: The complete flex-tangent incidence geometry is an intrinsic, natural invariant of the first non-Klein Hurwitz plane quintic over the first odd prime characteristic with nonexceptional flex support. It is not determined by the 42-flex geometric count: other highly symmetric curves have numerous triple and higher concurrences. The exact absence of any triple crossing and the closed-point zeta spectrum for all 861 nodes resolve a full dual-plane incidence problem and determine the arithmetic fields of every crossing, supporting future finite-geometry and line-arrangement work. This is not an arbitrary subset or parameter slice: the entire natural 42-line arrangement is classified.
